integrity: All claimed numerical profiles were recomputed with an exact standard-library back-and-forth type recursion, with a separate analytic lemma for all n,m at least 32. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only single directed cycles in the relational successor language and quantifier ranks one through five; the exact finite comparisons are verified by an exhaustive recursive program, the infinite tail by a separate gap strategy. No claim about functional languages, arbitrary bijections, or ranks six and above. Unindexed earlier cycle-specific rank tables remain a priority risk.
title: Sharp first-five quantifier-rank profiles of finite directed cycles
